paper.title: scikit-image: image processing in Python
paper.reference: van der Walt et al., PeerJ 2:e453 (2014), doi:10.7717/peerj.453

paper_context.research_question: Does the released image-metrics implementation return identity similarity for identical images?
paper_context.method: Compute structural similarity for two identical deterministic 8-by-8 arrays.
paper_context.data_and_splits: Synthetic image under this repository's MIT license.
paper_context.training_or_inference: No training; one CPU metric evaluation.
paper_context.evaluation_protocol: Run once and extract SSIM from JSON stdout.
paper_context.limitations: Algorithmic identity check, not a reproduction of every gallery example.

claims.protocol: Run once and extract SSIM from JSON stdout.
